source: Waszkiewicz 2025, Zenodo 18046315; authenticated FORM_A histories and D0 support
rights: CC-BY-4.0 source; original redraw; raw/native traces external
scope: 56 held-out brews; all eleven conditions and four predeclared weights; final 0.005-s evaluations

encodings.onset: signed condition-median errors; arrows are median lower bounds; 1–2 bar separate from 3.5–13
encodings.flow: condition-mean liquid scale endpoint against observed scale-derived beverage flow
encodings.pressure_loss: numeric F and O by pressure/weight/model; color is log(1+F+lambda*O), normalized separately per model; no probability interpretation
encodings.tradeoff: primary-trace RMSE against onset RMSE/computed bound; ↑ marks a lower bound; lines connect predeclared weights, not additional fits
encodings.intervals: none drawn; paired intervals in CSV condition on fitted parameters/fixed Mc

ceiling: No physical validation or identified mechanism; fitted scale lag remains observational; retrospective same-cohort capability only
